meta.parties: Carthelis Appuhamy v. Siriwaedena Et Al

rules.statement: A Court of Appeal is in as good a position to weigh the probabilities as the trial Judge, and failure to weigh or discuss facts supporting a finding that a will was 'unnatural or unreasonable' constitutes a serious misdirection.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think, further, that the failure of the Judge to weigh or discuss the facts on which he came to the conclusion that the will was 'unnatural or unreasonable' was a serious misdirection."
